paragraphs: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, Berakhot, chapter 5, mishnah 5. Rabbi Akiva ben Dosa is cited in Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1, chapter 2.

notes.text: In the consulted Mamo Iggeret edition, printed p. כא (PDF page 29), chapter 4, the text reads Rabbi Yaakov ben Dosa. The editor explicitly records the variant Rabbi Akiva ben Dosa, while adding that he did not locate this figure. This supports treating Hyman’s Akiva reading as a reported variant, not as an independently established identity. Hyman’s part 1, chapter 2 reference is retained; its exact printing has not been collated. The Chanina and Akiva notices do not establish one shared father.
